availability_audit: Chronology anchor: Route 113/114, Meteor Falls and Mt. Chimney is reached after Mauville/Wattson (cap 30) via Route 111 -> Route 112 -> Fiery Path, per Game Book C20/C21. Every member below is in work/reference-pools/pool-36.json with gate <= 36 and a source_detail map the player has already passed on the way to Route 113/114, Meteor Falls and Mt. Chimney: Seaspray Cave B1F (Sneasel), Rusturf Tunnel (Drilbur), Petalburg City Old Rod (Magikarp), Route 102 (Togepi), Mauville Game Corner (Litten), Granite Cave 1F (Abra). No Route 118+, Mt. Pyre, desert-interior or post-Flannery sources are used. Mega Ring earned from Steven after Brawly (C13); Gyaradosite stone window 20. Mt. Chimney is reached by the Route 112 cable car after the Meteor Falls scene per Game Book C21, so every source map above is behind the player. Adds Petalburg Woods (Heracross gate 14, Heracronite window 14). Gyaradosite stone window 20; the Mega Ring is earned from Steven after Brawly (C13).
plan: A sun grunt: Torkoal's Drought powers a full-HP Eruption and a Heat Wave lane, Simple Numel turns one Flame Charge into +2 Speed, Mawile is the physical Steel/Fairy body, and Sandygast is the Eviolite wall with Shore Up recovery. The important consequence of sun is that it halves my Water damage, so Mega Gyarados is the ace but not the opening - Earthquake is. Excadrill's Ground STAB is 2x into Torkoal, Numel and Mawile and is completely unaffected by the weather, and Togekiss is the Flying partner that lets it fire freely. Incineroar leads instead because it is a Fire type that resists the whole sun package and its Fake Out can deny the first, strongest Eruption, which is the one turn this team can genuinely win on. Two authored caveats I will respect: Water Compaction gives Sandygast +2 Defense when a Water move hits it and does NOT make it immune, so aiming Waterfall there is a trade rather than a mistake; and Numel's Simple doubles Flame Charge's Speed boost, so one unanswered Flame Charge reverses the speed order.
